comment: Append-only log of sanctioned pre-ECL freeze changes. Written by scripts/update-freeze.mjs (freeze_update / freeze_add) and scripts/advance-stage.mjs (stage_advance). The v62.3 entries below record the ECL P1 stage advance plus every hash mutation it required; they were re-materialized verbatim in v62.3.1 after the v62.3 working tree failed to persist, with the hashes re-read from disk, never from memory.

changes.reason: v62.3 — local pre-ECL gate closed (clean:check, policy, lint, typecheck:critical 0 errors, tests, build, baseline approved). ECL P1 is SCHEMA ONLY: six entity schemas, no engine, no scheduler, no UI, no billing effect.

ECL P1 — additive optional lifecycle fields (owner_email, confidence_result(+hash), evidence_status without default, provisional_started_at, expires_at, next_lifecycle_action_at, reminder_count, superseded_by_id). No writer, no required change, RLS untouched.

ECL P1 — additive optional fields (owner_email, statement_import_id, confidence_level_ecl as a SEPARATE categorical field, freeze_eligibility, rule_set_version, confidence_result(+hash)). The pre-existing numeric confidence_level keeps its meaning and its writers.
ECL P1 — new schema on the stage allowlist. Signed merchant declaration; HMAC-only fingerprints with a versioned key; retention PENDING legal/privacy review.
ECL P1 — new schema on the stage allowlist. Append-only by domain intent; to_status deliberately a free string so no auditable event is ever rejected.
ECL P1 — new schema on the stage allowlist. Scoped, always-expiring, withdrawable; the two-strike consequence is NOT implemented.
ECL P1 — new schema on the stage allowlist. Economic vs quality severity; no assignee, SLA, deadline or escalation until the review workflow is designed.
